نبذة

Located at the Leisure Centre at Arabian Ranches, this salon inspired by Salon Emotion from L’Oreal is the perfect serene haven to unwind and relax. In this spa, the color code is white and the interior code is spacious with dedicated rooms for facial and body treatments while the hair and nail sections include a consultation corner and a color bar. This flawless getaway offers clients a total beauty experience with services ranging from hair and nails treatments to tinting and waxing, from massages to body and facial treatments.

A welcoming, detail-focused approach gives Belle Femme Beauty Boutique & Spa - Arabian Ranches its distinctive character, with clients praising the care taken by the nail technicians and stylists.
